points.text: Paper lacks sufficient details to explain the methodology
Offline-compiled reusable function idea not explicitly framed; positioning in program synthesis weak
Success depends on exhaustive domain-specific prompts including environment code; generality and cost questionable
No principles for building prompts and no generated functions reported
Unclear why weighting multiple goals helps exploration; needs single-goal ablation
phi described as per-timestep but updated every 2M steps; inconsistent
'Structured goal-generation function' is vaguely defined
How priority weights are used to sample goals is not specified
Unclear how goal-weight set is encoded into single goal embedding
Differences between JAX and PyTorch implementations not explained
Only Crafter and Craftax-Classic, nearly identical; need diverse environments
Goals restricted to predefined achievements; LLM reweights rather than generates novel goals
Ablations on Craftax-Classic exclude ELLM and AdaRefiner baselines
How g_emb is computed and fed to the policy is not specified
Inconsistent notation, crowded tiny-font figures, many copy-editing artifacts
Eq. 6 confusingly mixes replay buffer and on-policy language in PPO
Masking via large constant C in Eq. 5 lacks stability discussion
SGRL much slower than PPO; 'faster' should be qualified as relative
No world-model or intrinsic-motivation baselines on Crafter/Craftax
ELLM/AdaRefiner partially reproduced; Crafter numbers copied from papers
Planner uses rich environment-specific text renderer; unclear if baselines had equal access
Restricted to Crafter variants; generalization to Minecraft or robotics unclear
ELLM and AdaRefiner only evaluated to 5M steps, weakening comparison
Multiple components need careful tuning, hindering reproduction and adaptation
LLM-written code and action masking are established; contribution is a combination
Goal function relies on task rules and human iteration; LLM prior vs human curriculum confounded
No variance across LLM generation runs; discarded runs not reported
DeepSeek-R1 may have memorized Crafter's tech tree
ELLM/AdaRefiner queried only every 200 steps, handicapping them
Crafter baseline numbers copied from original papers with different settings
No PPO/ELLM with same mask or hand-written goal heuristic to isolate LLM contribution
No comparison with DreamerV3, curiosity methods, SPRING or other Craftax baselines
Gains modest, reward not significantly better; speculative explanation untested
Ablation at 10M vs baselines at 5M; diamond claim unsupported at equal budgets
'Unlocks diamond after 3.7M steps' rests on uninspectable curves
Ablation differences small relative to std; no significance tests
Text says Figure 5 is Crafter but caption/table say Craftax-Classic
Crafter and Craftax experiments run on different hardware
Geometric mean score formula in A.2 is nonstandard
Achievement depth is coarse; depth-8 result is a binary effect
SGRL 7x slower than PPO despite efficiency claims
Number of LLM calls, tokens and total cost vs ELLM never reported
Single environment family; no other open-world domains; real-world claims overstated
No study of sensitivity to LLM choice, prompts or hyperparameters
Craftax-Classic is nearly saturated on some metrics
Eq. 5 multiplies logits by mask and subtracts C; nonstandard, may cause artifacts
Mask relaxed from 0.8T so final policy unmasked; xi semantics contradict text
PPO ratio computed under stochastically relaxed mask changes support
How goal weights are encoded in embedding unspecified, crucial for w/o Priority ablation
Goal planner given unlocked achievements, which is privileged feedback
Behavioral claims read from curves lack causal evidence
Related-work characterizations are sweeping
Main results are mostly placed in the appendix

P.summary: Insufficient methodology detail
Contribution not framed as offline compilation of LLM knowledge
Heavy domain-specific prompt engineering limits generality
No prompt-construction method or generated functions reported
Motivation for goal prioritization unclear; single-goal ablation missing
Definition and update schedule of phi inconsistent/vague
How priority weights sample goals unspecified
Encoding of goal-weight set into embedding unclear
JAX vs PyTorch implementation differences unexplained
Evaluation limited to Crafter variants; generality unclear
LLM only reweights predefined achievements
Ablations lack prior-method baselines
Poor readability: notation, crowded figures, copy-editing
Eq. 6 mixes on-policy and replay buffer language
Masking with large negative constant lacks justification
'Faster training' claim misleading versus PPO
Missing strong non-LLM exploration baselines
LLM baselines only partially reproduced or copied
Environment-specific text interface gives oracle-like advantage
Many interacting components hard to tune and reproduce

Q.summary: Limited novelty; combination of known ideas
Heavy domain knowledge and unquantified human prompt engineering
No variance across LLM-generation runs
Possible LLM memorization of Crafter
LLM baselines handicapped by query frequency
Crafter baseline numbers copied, uncontrolled
No controls with same action mask or hand-written heuristic
Missing other Crafter/Craftax methods
Modest gains; reward difference explained away
Unequal training budgets for claims
Diamond-at-3.7M claim rests on curves only
Small ablation differences without significance tests
Figure 5 environment labeled inconsistently
Compute differs between experiments
Nonstandard geometric mean score formula
Achievement depth is a coarse metric
Efficiency claims overstated; slower than PPO
LLM call cost and tokens unreported
Generality not demonstrated; single environment family
No sensitivity to LLM, prompts or hyperparameters
Craftax-Classic nearly saturated
Eq. 5 masking formulation nonstandard
Annealing schedule leaves final policy unmasked; xi semantics conflict
PPO ratio under stochastic relaxed mask
Goal weight encoding unspecified
Planner receives privileged achievement feedback
Claims asserted from curves with weak causal evidence
Sweeping related-work claims
Main results mostly in appendix
